title: fix(ui): restore Skills settings heading and align actions
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: Skills settings has no page heading and splits its primary actions across two rows.

## User Impact

User impact: The normal Skills title and description appear above one action row for Search skills, Workshop, Create skill, and Import skill. Narrow screens wrap the row without horizontal overflow.

## Why This Change Was Made

The settings surface rendered navigation outside the settings workspace while library actions lived inside it. The page now uses the shared settings header and one library-owned toolbar for the four actions; library scope and Refresh remain a separate controls row. No config, migration, or operator action is required.

## Evidence

- Baseline and candidate: isolated mocked Control UI at `/settings/skills`, same fixture and viewport, desktop `1440×900` and mobile `390×844`; inspected paired screenshots below.
- Regression test fails on the baseline because the heading is missing and passes on this patch. `skills-page.test.ts` (7/7), `view.test.ts`, and `skills-library.e2e.test.ts` (7/7) pass.
- `node scripts/check-changed.mjs -- ...` passes. Browser checks confirm no horizontal overflow; Search skills and Workshop remain visible while a Create skill draft is open.
- Owner: Skills settings page and library toolbar. Production delta: +122/−94 lines including a coherent toolbar extraction to keep the view below its line cap. Discovery's shared Plugins hub header is unchanged.

Desktop before and after, then mobile before and after:

![Before: settings Skills without heading and with split actions](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7248323e-2798-40f1-8617-e19c859aede8)

![After: Skills heading and aligned actions on desktop](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f87e110d-abe7-4bda-80f1-0a48c6753602)

![Before: split Skills actions on mobile](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b5153030-5539-44f0-9068-8c63ce5f2370)

![After: Skills heading and wrapping actions on mobile](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0b24acd8-7f1a-4862-9c49-c02782b49f94)

- Measured single-shard wall time: Skills page unit test 3.49s; Skills library browser E2E 26.72s. Exact-head CI ran 11m24s (05:24:12–05:35:36 UTC).
